nameForms.name: King of Jerusalem
nameForms.note: Latin Christian monarchy established after the First Crusade.
nameForms.noteCn: 第一次十字军东征后建立的拉丁基督教君主国。

holders.note: Elected after the capture of Jerusalem; he declined the royal title and used Defender of the Holy Sepulchre.
holders.noteCn: 耶路撒冷攻占后被推举；他拒绝使用国王称号，采用圣墓守护者称号。

holders.note: Succeeded his brother Godfrey and accepted the royal title.
holders.noteCn: 继承其兄戈弗雷并正式接受王号。

holders.note: Succeeded Baldwin I through the established royal succession.
holders.noteCn: 依照既定王室继承顺序继承鲍德温一世。

holders.note: Inherited the crown from her father and ruled with Fulk, then with Baldwin III as co-ruler.
holders.noteCn: 继承父亲的王冠，先与富尔克共治，后与鲍德温三世共治。

holders.note: Crowned as Melisende's co-ruler while still a minor.
holders.noteCn: 幼年加冕，与母亲梅利桑德共治。
继承其父阿马尔里克一世。

holders.note: Succeeded his uncle Baldwin IV as a child under regency.
holders.noteCn: 幼年继承其舅舅鲍德温四世，并由摄政辅政。

holders.note: Inherited the crown after Baldwin V's death and was crowned with Guy of Lusignan.
holders.noteCn: 鲍德温五世去世后继承王位，并与居伊·德·吕西尼昂共同加冕。

holders.note: Inherited the crown after Sibylla's death and was recognized through successive royal marriages.
holders.noteCn: 西比拉去世后继承王位，并通过连续的王室婚姻维持王位继承。
